fact: The 2025 Rwanda DHS (7th), fieldwork 5 June to 25 October 2025, drew its sample from the 2022 census enumeration areas and its key results were issued as a booklet in December 2025.
title: DHS Incamake y'ubushakashatsi ku mibereho n'ubuzima
publisher: Ikigo cy'Igihugu gishinzwe Ibarurishamibare mu Rwanda (NISR)
